evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce \textbf{AnalogLayoutWorld}, an open-source agent benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed tasks for end-to-end layout generation from fixed transistor-level netlists.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: It combines an integrated design environment with independent physical and post-layout electrical verification, as well as objective layout quality metrics co-designed with analog layout experts.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Across 13 model--harness configurations, 91.1\% of attempts produce GDS layouts, but only 23.0\% satisfy the benchmark's acceptance criteria.
